tasks.title: Decouple command lowering from LateBind (linear = relay && f32 only)
tasks.primary_variable: command organization change with identical math/wire
tasks.note: Initial actual-model opt-in failed closed: source graph capture and P1/P2 tape capture were still gated on LateBind despite selecting linear lowering; both now use the RELAY/F32 lowering predicate. Matched F32/device/binary/DSO five-block trials: 1..60 30.06→30.69 committed tok/s, B/A 1.0212 [1.0151,1.0273] (/tmp/tp5-b04-linear-5blocks.json); 1..100 33.50→34.39, B/A 1.0268 [1.0154,1.0381] (/tmp/tp5-b04-long-5blocks.json); both 20/20 exact. Although these gains are below the original 3% promotion rule, the user explicitly approved defaulting this already implemented small improvement on 2026-09-23. Only qualified five-distinct-RX6800, target-only RELAY with working command replay defaults to F32 plus lowering. /tmp/tp5-qualified-default-smoke.json and /tmp/tp5-qualified-linear-off-smoke.json pass complete 171-token answers; all ranks log reference mode with primary_cbs=1 only in the default, opt-out env=0 preserves ordinary F32. Golden explicitly sets lowering=0; speculative MTP retains old wire default and remains opt-in. Different effective batches and other task quality are not performance-proven. Existing RELAY already submits one whole-chain VkSubmitInfo per rank: not a submit-count reduction.

tasks.title: Definition-time Program / RunInputs separation with structure generation
tasks.primary_variable: warm-chain work: full stage_key/stage_compute_cbs vector compare vs generation check
tasks.unmeasured_cost: stage_compute_cbs deep-compare is per-token O(n_stages x n_ranks); no measured wall-time attribution
tasks.safety_gate: child Vulkan CB re-recording, scratch/buffer relocation, and direct collective callers must invalidate a definition generation before deep equality can be removed
tasks.current_decision: keep deep equality and cached CB fingerprint checks; do not invent a child generation API solely to remove a cheap, unmeasured comparison. The backend-meta predefined UID fast path skips child CB lookup, while child validity depends on graph buffer fingerprints; a partial generation would make stale VkCommandBuffers more likely. No performance promotion without measured attribution and all-caller relocation/lifetime coverage.
